70.label: Can a vaccine give you the disease it protects against?
70.content: Killed, piece, and mRNA vaccines contain no living germ that can make you sick. Weakened vaccines can, very rarely, cause a mild version of the illness in people with very weak immune systems. That's why doctors check before giving them. Feeling tired or sore afterward is your immune system training, not the disease.

70.label: Why do some vaccines need boosters?
70.content: Memory from some vaccines slowly fades. A booster reminds your memory cells and tops up their numbers, like reviewing notes before an exam.

70.label: Why is there a new flu shot every year?
70.content: Flu viruses keep changing their antigens. Last year's memory cells may not recognize this year's version, so the vaccine is updated to match.

71.prompt: What does a vaccine show your immune system so it can learn?

options.label: A full-strength version of the disease
A germ's antigen, without a dangerous infection
Ready-made memory cells from another person

71.hint: Think about the wanted poster your specialists study.
71.explanation: Vaccines present antigens through weakened germs, killed germs, germ pieces, or mRNA instructions. Your own body then builds the antibodies and memory cells.

71.prompt: Why is the second encounter with a germ usually much milder than the first?

options.label: Memory cells recognize it and respond in days, not weeks
The germ gets weaker each time it infects you
First responders learn to remember the germ
Antibodies from the first infection stay at peak levels forever

71.hint: Which cells stay behind after the first fight?
71.explanation: Memory B and T cells remain after the first exposure. They launch a faster, much stronger response, often before you feel sick.

71.prompt: True or false: A sore arm or mild fever after a vaccine means you've caught the disease.
71.hint: Recall what happens in days 1 to 3 of the worked example.
71.explanation: Those symptoms come from first responders raising the alarm. They are a sign your immune system is training, not that you are infected.
